Simple waitlist and table-status tracker for small restaurants like my parents' 40-seat place.
Problem: hosts track waitlists on paper; quoted wait times are guesses; no-shows waste tables.

cat > tableflow.py <<'EOF'
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

@dataclass
class Party:
    name: str
    size: int
    added: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    status: str = "waiting"  # waiting | seated | no_show

class Waitlist:
    def __init__(self, tables: int, avg_turn_minutes: int = 60):
        self.tables = tables
        self.avg_turn = avg_turn_minutes
        self.parties: list[Party] = []

    def add(self, name: str, size: int) -> Party:
        p = Party(name, size)
        self.parties.append(p)
        return p

    def quote_minutes(self, party: Party) -> int:
        ahead = [p for p in self.parties if p.status == "waiting" and p.added <= party.added]
        ahead_count = len(ahead) - 1
        return max(0, round(ahead_count / self.tables * self.avg_turn))

    def seat_next(self) -> Party | None:
        for p in self.parties:
            if p.status == "waiting":
                p.status = "seated"
                return p
        return None

    def mark_no_show(self, party: Party):
        party.status = "no_show"

if __name__ == "__main__":

    for name, size in [("Lee", 2), ("Garcia", 4), ("Patel", 6)]:
        p = w.add(name, size)
        print(f"{name} ({size}): quoted ~{w.quote_minutes(p)} min")
    print("Seated:", w.seat_next().name)
EOF

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

@dataclass
class Party:
    name: str
    size: int
    added: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    status: str = "waiting"  # waiting | seated | no_show

class Waitlist:
    def __init__(self, tables: int, avg_turn_minutes: int = 60):
        self.tables = tables
        self.avg_turn = avg_turn_minutes
        self.parties: list[Party] = []

    def add(self, name: str, size: int) -> Party:
        p = Party(name, size)
        self.parties.append(p)
        return p

    def quote_minutes(self, party: Party) -> int:
        ahead = [p for p in self.parties if p.status == "waiting" and p.added <= party.added]

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime

@dataclass
class Party:
    name: str
    size: int
    added: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    status: str = "waiting"  # waiting | seated | no_show

class Waitlist:
    def __init__(self, tables: int, avg_turn_minutes: int = 60):
        self.tables = tables
        self.avg_turn = avg_turn_minutes
        self.parties: list[Party] = []

        p = Party(name, size)
        self.parties.append(p)
        return p

    def quote_minutes(self, party: Party) -> int:
        ahead = [p for p in self.parties if p.status == "waiting" and p.added <= party.added]
        ahead_count = len(ahead) - 1
        return max(0, round(ahead_count / self.tables * self.avg_turn))

                return p
        return None

from datetime import datetime

@dataclass
class Party:

    size: int
    added: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)

        self.parties.append(p)

                return p
        return None

    def mark_no_show(self, party: Party):

# TableFlow (prototype)
Simple waitlist and table-status tracker for small restaurants like my parents' 40-seat place.
Problem: hosts track waitlists on paper; quoted wait times are guesses; no-shows waste tables.
This prototype: add parties to a waitlist, quote wait times from average turn time, mark seated/no-show.
Run: python3 tableflow.py
